Membership Requirements

 

 

Membership Requirements are as follows:

1. You must be an active role player. Although Out Of Character comments cannot be helped, we know, we ask that you specify when you are speaking in OOC Format, or keep them to tells. We wish to maximize role playing, and not crossing the boundaries of In Character and Out Of Character.

2. Being in the Chiaroscuro means being an active member. This means active participation, helping and hunting with other members, seeking out new ideas for quests and guild run storylines. Speaking to everyone in the guild and letting everyone basically know you exist for more than just a guild tag. This won't be tolerated.

3. Recruiting, We ask that you only recruit those you have hunted with, and those whom you know to be experienced, mature and honourable role players. We won't tolerate kill stealers, trouble makers..so forth. Please know, if you are an officer or not, you are responsible for the actions of those you sponsor. You must also get the approval of one officer before suggesting the member for entry into the guild.

4. We ask that you make weekly posts, specifying IC or OOC, to the message board. We would like everyone to interact there as well. Letting us all know what is happening, how lives and levels are progressing, what is needed and what is available.

Officer Requirements and Standards

1. An officer, if chosen to be so, has been chosen because they show support, activity and promise within the guild. Therefore we expect this to continue after you are given that status.

2. As an officer, you are responsible for scouting out new members and helping regular members with guild hunts as well as creating storylines. Your suggestions for promotions and ideas for rules, additions and adaptations will be highly sought after.

3. An officer is also responsible for helping to settle disputes within the guild. We don't expect you to police people, just offer assistance.

We allow all alignments, races, classes and levels into the Chiaroscuro, we ask you act like a family. Like any family, there are disagreements and problems, but while in the Chiaroscuro, everyone here is an equal and no one is superiour. We just ask you roleplay and have fun :) Just...not too much.
